proposals.explanation: 薛瑩 is cited as the author of the 後漢書 annotation source (薛瑩後漢書曰). The evidence identifies him as the citation author of the historical text quoted in the Liu annotation. He is a historical person, the compiler of a 後漢書, cited as the source for the biographical note on 李膺.

陳元方 is the full name form (surname 陳 + courtesy name 元方) of 陳紀, son of 陳寔 (太丘). The main text identifies 陳元方 as the elder brother of 季方 (陳諶), and the annotation references 陳羣字長文 whose 祖寔 is 陳寔. The annotation also confirms 元方 as a courtesy name. 陳元方 = 陳紀, the elder son of 陳寔.
The main text refers to 阮嗣宗, and the Liu annotation explicitly states 阮籍字嗣宗, confirming that 嗣宗 is the courtesy name of 阮籍. The target mention 阮嗣宗 uses the courtesy name to refer to the person 阮籍.

袁府君 is an office-title reference (府君 being a respectful title for a prefect/governor) to a person surnamed 袁 who led the campaign against 孫恩 in 吳郡. The main text identifies this person only as 袁府君; no fuller name is supplied in the evidence. The Liu annotation does not provide the identity of this 袁. Therefore the referent surface is 袁府君 and no canonical fuller name can be justified from the supplied evidence.

The target 太丘長 is an office title (Chief of Taiqiu) held by 陳仲弓 (陳寔). The main text identifies 陳仲弓 as the person holding this office, and the Liu annotation confirms 寔/陳 as the person. The office title refers to the person 陳寔 who served as 太丘長.

王藍田 refers to 王述, who was enfeoffed as 藍田侯 (per liu annotation 003: 襲爵藍田侯). The liu annotations identify 王述 (字懷祖, 太原晉陽人) as the person who was 為王導所辟, and the main text lists 王藍田 among those gathered by 王丞相. The annotation 004 confirms 王濛王述並為王導所辟, matching the main text's 王長史 (王濛) and 王藍田 (王述).

The main text mentions 汰法師, and the Liu annotation explicitly glosses this as 法汰 (法汰者...也), identifying the person as 法汰, a Buddhist monk. The annotation also notes 一説法汰即安公弟子, connecting him as a disciple of 安公 (道安). The target 汰法師 is an office-title form referring to the monk 法汰.

The target mention 滔 appears in liu-annotation-003 in the phrase 時伏滔在温府與, where the full name 伏滔 is explicitly given in the same annotation (mention sfh1-mention-bee89791c4f0450644273eee, surface 伏滔). The single-character 滔 is a personal-name abbreviation of 伏滔, who is identified in the same annotation as being in 桓温's 府. The annotation text 宏善苦諌之宏笑而不荅滔宻以啓温 confirms 滔 is the person who secretly reported to 温, consistent with 伏滔 being present in 温府.

王師 refers to the imperial/royal army as a collective body, not an individual person. In the context of the Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-05-fangzheng-034-liu-annotation-005), it describes the defeat of the imperial forces (王師敗績) in the context of 蘇峻's rebellion. This is a collective reference to the government/imperial troops.
鍾士季 is the courtesy name (字) of 鍾會. The Liu annotation explicitly identifies 鍾會 in connection with this passage, confirming that 鍾士季 refers to 鍾會.

The main text states 劉粹字純嘏, identifying 劉粹 as one of the three 嘏 brothers (三嘏) in 洛中. The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-08-shangyu-022-liu-annotation-001) confirms 粹 as 沛國人 who 歷侍中南中郎將. This is a full-name reference to the historical person 劉粹.

宋明帝 appears in the Liu Xiaobiao annotation as the author of the 文章志 (宋明帝文章志), a literary compilation. This is a ruler title referring to the Emperor Ming of Liu Song (劉宋明帝, 劉彧). The annotation cites his work 文章志 as the source for the biographical note on 劉恢. The evidence supports identifying this as a historical person referenced by ruler title, serving as citation author of the 文章志.

The main text mentions 周伯仁 (courtesy name 伯仁) and later in the same passage refers to 周顗 by full name. The Liu annotation also glosses 伯仁 as 清 (referring to 周顗's character). The courtesy name 伯仁 refers to 周顗, whose courtesy name is 伯仁.

温太真 is the courtesy name (字太真) of 温嶠, a Jin dynasty figure. The main text refers to him as 温太真, and the Liu annotations discuss the 温 surname lineage (温氏譜序, 太原祁縣), confirming the 温 family context. 太真 is 温嶠's courtesy name, and the full name 温嶠 is the historical referent.

阮思曠 is the courtesy name (字) of 阮裕, a Jin dynasty figure. The text lists him among notable contemporaries being evaluated by 孫興公 (孫綽). 阮裕's courtesy name was 思曠. The surface form 阮思曠 combines surname 阮 with courtesy name 思曠, a common way of referring to a person in Shishuo Xinyu.

The pronoun 吾 in the main text is spoken by 魏武 (Cao Cao). In the passage, 魏武 says '吾巳得' (I have got it), referring to himself. The validated local mention sfh1-mention-00469f202f6f0f886d251bca identifies 魏武 as a person (ruler_title) in the same main text. The pronoun 吾 is first-person self-reference by 魏武, who is Cao Cao (曹操).

The target 嵇叔夜 is the style name (字) of 嵇康. The main text opens with 嵇康身長七尺八寸 and then 山公曰嵇叔夜之為人也, clearly identifying 嵇叔夜 as the style name referring to the same person 嵇康. The Liu annotation also refers to 康 (嵇康) in the same entry. The style name 叔夜 is well-attested for 嵇康.

海内 is a collective reference meaning 'within the seas' / 'the whole realm' (all people within the empire), used here as a descriptive collective reference to the people of the realm who look up to 衛洗馬 as a 風流名士. It is not an independent person.

茂弘 is the courtesy name of 王導. The main text mentions 王丞相 (王導 as Chancellor) who wishes to recruit 李廞, and 廞 responds saying 茂弘乃復以一爵假人. The Liu annotation confirms 導 (王導) is referred to by the courtesy name 茂弘, and the annotation text explicitly pairs 導 with 茂弘 as courtesy name.

The target mention 康 is a one-character personal name that directly follows 嵇 in the preceding validated mention 嵇康 (sfh1-mention-f213595fda49bd07c38048ea). The text reads 譙國嵇康河内山濤, and the target 康 is the personal name portion of 嵇康, referring to the same person. The evidence explicitly names 嵇康 as one of the 竹林七賢.

The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-23-rendan-017-liu-annotation-001) explicitly identifies 劉道真 as 劉寶 (已見/劉寳). The main text describes 劉道真 as a person who later became 吏部郞, consistent with the annotation's identification. The annotation provides the canonical name 劉寶 for the person referred to by the courtesy name 道真 with surname 劉.

The pronoun 卿 is used by 庾亮 addressing 温太真 (温嶠). In the text, 温太真 calls out to 庾亮 saying 卿可贖我 ('you can redeem me'), so 卿 refers to 庾亮, the addressee. Wait—re-reading: 温太真 calls out 亮曰卿可贖我. So 温太真 addresses 庾亮 with 卿. Therefore 卿 refers to 庾亮.

The target '之' is a pronoun referring to the person 劉遺民 (劉驎之), the man who brought fish to 張玄's boat. The Liu annotation explicitly states 一字遺民已見中興書曰劉驎之, confirming 劉遺民 is 劉驎之. The pronoun '之' in '問其姓字稱是劉遺民...張甚欲話言劉了無停意' refers to this same person.

The target mention 嘏 appears in the Liu annotation text '傅嘏往喭粲' where the full name 傅嘏 is explicitly given in the same annotation (sfh1-ev-35-huoni-002-liu-annotation-003). The single character 嘏 is a personal-name abbreviation of 傅嘏, who is the person visiting 荀粲 after his wife's death. The validated local mention sfh1-mention-a3d17929bcac44e23f154f8e confirms 傅嘏 as the full form in the same evidence.
